On one hand, this allows you to check out DLC if your friend/anyone on a public server is hosting a DLC reserve. 

On the other hand. As of time of writing this review, it is 109 GB. Red Dead Redemption 2 is 118 GB. HOW IN THE NAME OF HELL IS THIS GAME ONLY 9 GB LESS THAN RDR2? This game forces you to download every damn unoptimized DLC, and its just making it bloat more and more no matter how much I do not want to buy these damn guns or feeders.

If you have a ton of storage on your PC to burn? Hell, go for it, play the game. But wait for sales and use your money wisely, because there is so much DLC here that you can drain your coffers fast if you're not careful. Saw someone else say the game is ~310$ if you're paying full price for all the current DLC.

If you're like me and don't have 109 GBs to spare to a game that just keeps bloating, do not buy this game.

Benim için sakin ve huzurlu bir şekilde ormanda dolaşıp kafa dağıttığım bir oyun gibi başladı. Köpeğimle birlikte iz sürerek, bazen yürüyerek bazen koşarak haritada gezmek bile başlı başına keyif veriyor. Oyun dışarıdan bakınca “rahat avcılık simülasyonu” gibi duruyor ama işin içine girince olayın ciddiyeti hemen anlaşılıyor.

Özellikle atış kısmı sandığımdan çok daha zor. Scope kullanmadan 50-100-150 metre gibi mesafelerden pompalı ile atış yapmak gerçekten ayrı bir seviye. CS oynayanlar “aimim iyi” diye girerse burada işin sadece aim olmadığını anlıyorlar. Çünkü burada mesafe, mermi düşüşü, rüzgâr ve hayvanın hareketi gibi birçok şey aynı anda devreye giriyor. Yani tek atış ya her şeyi çözüyor ya da tamamen kaçırıyorsun :D

Oyunun en güzel tarafı aslında bu denge. Bir yanda tamamen sakin orman yürüyüşü, diğer yanda tek bir atışta her şeyin değiştiği o gerilim anı. Tutturunca aşırı tatmin ediyor, tutturamayınca da insanın “ben nerede hata yaptım” diye düşünmesine sebep oluyor.

Genel olarak benim için hem kafa boşaltmalık hem de sabır ve dikkat isteyen bir avcılık deneyimi.

My views on this game are mostly neutral, but leaning more towards positive. Let me start off with this game has an absolute crazy amount of content for $20. This game has I think 18 maps (only 2 are free but you can play the other ones), many different species, lots of different weapons, and much more. But man a lot of content is locked behind a paywall. You want a rifle that can hit class 1 animals? You need to pay. You want a blind to hide in? You need to pay. You want new weapons? You need to pay. You want an electronic lure? You need to pay. You want ANYTHING related to an animal on one of the paid maps? You need to pay. You want a new map? You need to pay. Let me say one thing, if you completely ignore ALL the paid stuff and didn't know it was there, it's well worth the money. It still is for how much content you get, but I would rather the game just be $60 and give half the DLCs. They even made it to where you can join multiplayer servers on maps you don't own, as long as someone in the server owns it. But man, it is so annoying that my only options to get class 1 animals with the correct ammo type is a bow or a shotgun, both of which are close range. This game is really worth it, but it leaves a sour taste in your mouth with how much features that should be included in the base game but are locked behind a DLC.
